projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Regional Pacific offshore southward California Current43–23N. Exclude northward California Undercurrent,Davidson/nearshore poleward flow,Gulf ofCalifornia and downstreamNorthEquatorialcontinuation. Broad meridional-component maxima can still include eddies,filaments or upwelling jets;not an independently validated whole-system axis or cross-shore representative depth. Source150/500m literature extents are distinct spatial summaries,not depth targets or seasonal bounds.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use the declared longitude-gate midpoint at the actual source latitude only as an explicitly marked unresolved geometry placeholder,never as a sampled axis or supported depth. Connect neighboring positions by shortestWGS84reference legs;assume linear lower depth and paired model span only between adjacent original supported nodes. No skip,extrapolation or alternate-threshold depth fill. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current length.
